BF-KOS.name: Kossi
BF-KOS.reason: No plausible GeoNames candidate for Burkina Faso's Kossi province. The full candidate list for BF is missing Kossi, Oubritenga, Sanmatenga, Soum, and Tapoa, but includes 5 unfamiliar names (Koosin, Bassitenga, Djelgodji, Gobnangou, Sandbondtenga) that don't match any known real-world province names or transliterations with confidence -- looks like a source data quality issue rather than a naming variant.

BF-SMT.name: Sanmatenga
BF-SMT.reason: No plausible GeoNames candidate for Burkina Faso's Sanmatenga province. Same underlying issue as BF-KOS: the BF candidate list is missing several real provinces (Kossi, Oubritenga, Sanmatenga, Soum, Tapoa) and instead has unfamiliar names (Koosin, Bassitenga, Djelgodji, Gobnangou, Sandbondtenga). 'Sandbondtenga' shares the common Mossi place-name suffix '-tenga' with Sanmatenga but I have no confident real-world basis to equate them as the same place rather than two distinct localities.

BF-TAP.name: Tapoa
BF-TAP.reason: No plausible GeoNames candidate for Burkina Faso's Tapoa province. Same underlying data gap as BF-KOS: the BF list has an unfamiliar name 'Gobnangou' (real Gobnangou massif/escarpment does run through Tapoa province, but I don't have confident real-world basis that 'Gobnangou' is used as an alternate name for the whole province, unlike the Djelgodji/Soum case which I merged).

ET-SN.name: Southern Nations
ET-SN.reason: Former SNNPR was split (2019-2023) into 4 successor regions now in GeoNames (South Ethiopia Regional State, Sidama Region, South West Ethiopia Peoples' Region, Central Ethiopia Regional State) - no single correct 1:1 match, needs human decision on how to represent the split
